Q: Run a function from dropdownlist value in Google App script A:

You can't access the DOM using getElementById before it has loaded. Move your script tag after <body> tag.

Q: Is there any good way to make an animation at page load? A:

One tip I can give you that you only need to modify the opacity of the <body>, not of everything. That means half your code can go.

Another tip would be to store the current URL in the session and compare that. This would allow you to reuse the animation for every URL of your website, meaning that every page would fade in, but only if the new URL is different from the previous. So on a reload/refresh the page would be visible immediately. Something like this:

https://codepen.io/kikosoft/pen/WbGGNpY?editors=1111

Sorry, the example won't run here, that's why it is in a code pen. The reason is that it uses the <body> element. Perhaps not the best idea? Better using a class or identifier.

You might run into another problem when you have pages that take long to load. The page will stay blank until it is fully loaded. Also, on a refresh, it might still blink. But for simple pages this will be fine.

Q: Plotting mplot3d / axes3D xyz surface plot with log scale? A:

This has been fixed with the merge of https://github.com/matplotlib/matplotlib/pull/30980 and will be available in matplotlib 3.11.

Setting 3D axes to log, symlog, or any other scale transform will work with the same command as in 2D:

ax.set_xscale('log')

Q: How does precedence work when using CodeIgniter's where() and or_where() method calls A:

This is the best way

$where = "(`from` = '1' AND `delivered` = 1) OR (`to` = '1' AND `delivered` = 1)";
$this->db->select('message,from')->from('chat_messages')->where($where);

Just remember 1 thing that in short AND is multiplication, OR is addition so as per bodmas rule AND is on priority. This is some sort of practical example which we follow in our coding. So always separate AND, OR glue with brackets like:

(`from` = '1' AND `delivered` = 1) OR (`to` = '1' AND `delivered` = 1)
